name: Amica Mutual
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public amica.com pages only (no sign-in, no form submitted). Billing & payment options: e-bill (e-discount with e-bill + e-policy, not all states, not life), pay online or schedule a future payment, AutoPay with a bank account waives installment fees, processing up to three business days; life billed separately; scheduled payments not for Amica Life. Billing FAQ: EFT, debit/credit (Visa, MasterCard, Discover, AmEx, Apple Pay); update methods in Billing > Payment Methods; cancel a just-submitted payment in Billing before midnight ET on the submission date; schedule up to the next due date; posted payments under Transaction History in Billing; e-bill under Profile; auto/home/marine/umbrella pay by phone 800-242-6422 and mail to Amica Mutual Insurance Company, PO Box 9128, Providence, RI 02940-9128; life 800-894-4228 (FAQ; catalog had 844-894-4228 which the guest page shows for Life Customer Service). AutoPay by bank account or card. Login page: Login ID + Password on one screen, 'Forgot Login ID/Password?', 'Create an account', 'Pay as Guest' (policy type picker first; lookup fields not observed without proceeding, family defaults kept). Guest page hours: general M-F 6 a.m.-10 p.m., Sat-Sun 7 a.m.-8 p.m. ET. Installment fee amounts are not published. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): Amica Life phone in help set to 844-894-4228, the number on the Billing and Payment Options page and the Pay as Guest page (the FAQ's 800-894-4228 is the outlier); Amica Life mailing address added. Public nav set from the login page and Billing and Payment Options page so the captured header row (ZIP prompt, 'Log out', 'Update') no longer shows on public pages.

scheduled_payment.note: You can schedule a payment for any date up to your next payment due date. Scheduled payments are not available for Amica Life.

autopay.note: AutoPay with a bank account waives installment fees.

help.title: What are my options for making payments?
paragraphs: Pay online, by phone or by U.S. mail. Online you can use your bank account (EFT) or a Visa, MasterCard, Discover or American Express debit or credit card, or Apple Pay. No account? Choose Pay as Guest.

For auto, home, marine and umbrella policies call 800-242-6422 to pay by phone, or mail your payment to Amica Mutual Insurance Company, PO Box 9128, Providence, RI 02940-9128. Life and annuity payments go to Amica Life Insurance Company, PO Box 9700, Providence, RI 02940-9700, or call Amica Life at 844-894-4228.
Allow up to three business days after the scheduled payment date for your bank to process the payment.

help.title: Schedule or cancel a payment
paragraphs: You can schedule a payment for any date up until your next payment due date. Scheduled payments are not available for Amica Life products.

To cancel a payment you just submitted, open the Billing section of your account, where pending payments are listed. Cancel by midnight Eastern time on the day you submitted it so your account is not charged.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: With AutoPay your payments are deducted automatically from your bank account or charged to your credit card.
Signing up for AutoPay with a bank account waives installment fees. Installment plans, fees and discounts depend on product, terms and payment method.

help.title: e-bill and the e-discount
paragraphs: Sign up for e-bill under the Profile section of your account. If you enroll in both e-bill and e-policy you may qualify for the e-discount (not in every state, and not for life policies).
Posted payments appear under Transaction History in the Billing section. Update or remove saved methods on the Payment Methods tab.
